Apele Arabiei
programme.desc: Apele oceanelor sunt pline de animale carnivore. Vedeți rechinii și pisicile de mare care patrulează în recifele de corali, în căutarea prăzii. Învățați despre peștii toxici care se deghizează ca să-i surprindă în ambuscadă pe cei neprevăzători, precum și despre prădători cu armuri care devorează prăzi vulnerabile.

programme.title: Insectele care stăpânesc lumea
programme.desc: Iată ce ar putea face planetei noastre un declin global al insectelor. Descoperiți dependența noastră istorică de aceste mici animale, rolurile vitale pe care le joacă în ecosistemele noastre și de ce relația noastră fragilă cu ele este în pericol.

programme.title: Priveliști nedescoperite
programme.desc: Pădurea tropicală întâlnește Marea Caraibilor în această regiune uluitoare din estul Mexicului. Vă aventurați în jungla de nepătruns, vă afundați în peșterile subacvatice misterioase și rătăciți prin desișurile luxuriante unde trăiește cel mai mare prădător din Mexic, crocodilul lui Morelet.

programme.title: Priveliști nedescoperite
programme.desc: În centrul Mexicului se află Sierra Gorda, o regiune alcătuită din multe lumi. Urcați spre cer, de la 300 la 3.000 m deasupra nivelului mării, începând cu dealurile joase a unui vechi semi-deșert, până la o pădure tropicală montană, deasă, plină de râși, pume și veverițe zburătoare.

programme.title: Fauna din adâncuri
programme.desc: Coasta sălbatică a Mozambicului se întinde pe o lungime de peste 2.500 km - o zonă plină de viețuitoare marine. Unele dintre cele mai mari animale marine care se hrănesc prin filtrare sunt atrase de aceste ape bogate în nutrimente. Dar chiar și aceste viețuitoare mari sunt lipsite de apărare față de pescuitul excesiv. Andrea Marshall și Nakia Cullain, doi dintre principalii cercetători marini din Mozambic, pornesc în căutarea unuia dintre cele mai eluzive animale și le protejează pe cele mai cunoscute dintre ele, înainte să fie prea târziu.

programme.title: Supersimțuri
programme.desc: Viziunea - este modul în care nouăzeci și cinci la sută dintre animale interpretează lumea. Fiecare specie de pe Pământ este un capitol din fascinanta poveste a vederii. În acest episod urmărim povestea, de la începuturi neclare până la uluitoarea viziune hexnoculară.

programme.title: Lumi uriașe
programme.desc: Cărăbușii locuiesc pe Terra de mai bine de 240 de milioane de ani. Există cam 380.000 de specii de cărăbuși cunoscute oamenilor de știință și în fiecare an sunt descoperite alte sute de specii noi. Un sfert din animalele lumii sunt cărăbuși. Au cucerit aproape fiecare colț și habitat de pe planetă și au supraviețuit fiecărui dezastru global. Ce anume îi face să aibă așa mare succes?

programme.title: Secretele pădurilor fermecate
programme.desc: Urmați ecuatorul pentru a observa diferitele specii care trăiesc în pădurile tropicale. Faceți cunoștință cu un leneș singuratic dintr-o mini-pădure, lemuri care împart totul și elefanți care au grijă de grădinile lor forestiere. Apoi explorați partea întunecată a regiunii.

programme.title: Misterele evoluției
programme.desc: Cooperarea îmbracă multe forme. Unele animale cooperează pentru a socializa, în timp ce altele pun bunăstarea grupului deasupra propriilor capacități de reproducere. Observați evoluția multiplelor modalități de a colabora ale speciilor pentru a supraviețui.

programme.title: Insectele care stăpânesc lumea
programme.desc: Aflați cum albinele, fluturii, moliile și alți polenizatori mențin câmpurile și pădurile roditoare. Cum ar fi viața fără aceste insecte ocupate ? Urmăriți un misterios pelerinaj al fluturilor și cum scapă o molie de liliecii înfometați.

programme.title: Salvarea faunei Pacificului
programme.desc: Suntem alături de veterinar și echipa lui pentru salvarea unui leu de mare care e prins într-o legătură din plastic, apoi mergem la Centrul de Salvare unde un pui de focă ar putea orbi, iar un pui de vidră are nevoie de o operație riscantă, dar salvatoare.

programme.title: Salvarea faunei Pacificului
programme.desc: Deși vântul e foarte puternic și valurile sunt mari, se duce o luptă pentru salvarea unui leu de mare prins într-o legătură din plastic. Apoi, la Centrul de Salvare, peste 80 de foci orfane trebuie să fie hrănite de mai multe ori pe zi ca să fie eliberare în sălbăticie, iar o rață de Amazon trece printr-o operație magică.

programme.title: Fauna din adâncuri
programme.desc: Coasta Mozambicului găzduiește giganți precum balenele cu cocoașă sau rechinii-balenă, însă și speciile foarte mici joacă un rol la fel de important în ecosistem. Faceți cunoștință cu oamenii de știință care se luptă din greu să protejeze toate animalele de coastă, indiferent de dimensiunea lor.

programme.title: Supersimțuri
programme.desc: Urmăriți animalele care forțează limitele fizicii, chimiei și ingineriei cu realizări la care oamenii pot doar să viseze și aflați cum evoluția le-a oferit astfel de talente uimitoare. Uneori, o super-putere este necesară chiar și numai pentru a supraviețui.

programme.title: Secretele pădurilor fermecate
programme.desc: Urmăriți trecerea anotimpurilor și aflați cum se ajută reciproc arborii și animelele pentru a supraviețui. Bucurați-vă de licuricii de primăvară care dansează prin noapte, descoperiți ciupercile de vară care răcoresc arborii și pregătiți-vă de toamnă odată cu căderea frunzelor.

programme.title: Misterele evoluției
programme.desc: Unii le numesc ”fosile vii”, dar acesta este doar un alt mod de a spune că sunt niște supraviețuitori. De la rechini la crabi potcoavă, adaptările acestor animale au fost un succes, lăsându-i relativ neschimbați de milioane de ani.

programme.title: Insectele care stăpânesc lumea
programme.desc: Înfruntați insecte prădătoare făcute pentru a ucide. Vedeți de ce terifianta călugăriță are agilitatea unui specialist în arte marțiale și un apetit pentru orice, de la muște la colibri, apoi vânați în aer cu libelulele mortale.

programme.title: Odraslele furtunii
programme.desc: Iarna se îmblânzește. În Islanda, vulpile arctice fug prin munți pentru a se împerechea. În Shetland, o vidră își crește puii. În Norvegia, o turmă de reni coboară spre locurile de fătare. O furtună uriașă de martie se dezlănțuie în Stormborn.

programme.title: Odraslele furtunii
programme.desc: Animalele din nordul Atlanticului au parte de o vară scurtă și intensă. Puii de vulpe arctică învață să vâneze pentru a supraviețui, un pui de vidră merge singur pentru prima dată, un biban își caută perechea și micii reni fac primii pași.

programme.title: Fauna din adâncuri
programme.desc: Oceanul se întinde pe 70% din suprafața planetei noastre și în el trăiesc în jur de un milion de specii cunoscute de plante și animale. Totuși, cele mai mici creaturi oceanice stau la baza celei mai ample resurse de hrană din lume - planctonul. Aceste organisme microscopice plutesc prin habitatele diverse ale oceanului, declanșând cicluri de hrănire pe unde trec. În absența lor nu ar mai exista viață în ocean.

programme.title: Supersimțuri
programme.desc: Intrați cu încredere în lumea orbitoare de dincolo de percepția umană, unde animalele își folosesc super-simțurile pentru a detecta lumină pe care noi nu o vedem, sunete pe care nu le auzim și chiar forțe mai stranii pe care nu avem nicio șansă de a le detecta.

programme.title: Salvarea faunei Pacificului
programme.desc: Suntem alături de veterinar și echipa lui pentru salvarea unui leu de mare care e prins într-o legătură din plastic, apoi mergem la Centrul de Salvare unde un pui de focă ar putea orbi, iar un pui de vidră are nevoie de o operație riscantă, dar salvatoare.

programme.title: Salvarea faunei Pacificului
programme.desc: Deși vântul e foarte puternic și valurile sunt mari, se duce o luptă pentru salvarea unui leu de mare prins într-o legătură din plastic. Apoi, la Centrul de Salvare, peste 80 de foci orfane trebuie să fie hrănite de mai multe ori pe zi ca să fie eliberare în sălbăticie, iar o rață de Amazon trece printr-o operație magică.

programme.title: Secretele pădurilor fermecate
programme.desc: Descoperiți zonele umede, unde arborii și apa lucrează împreună pentru o viață nouă. Cufundați-vă într-o pădure subacvatică ce protejează puii de focă, vizitați un sanctuar de mangrove în care se ascunde un grup de animale acvatice curioase și întâlniți câțiva monștri adevărați ai mlaștinilor.

programme.title: Insectele care stăpânesc lumea
programme.desc: Înfruntați insecte prădătoare făcute pentru a ucide. Vedeți de ce terifianta călugăriță are agilitatea unui specialist în arte marțiale și un apetit pentru orice, de la muște la colibri, apoi vânați în aer cu libelulele mortale.

programme.title: Simțurile animalelor
programme.desc: Primul simț care a apărut la cele dintâi animale a fost chemorecepția: capacitatea de a detecta substanțe chimice în mediul animalului. Astfel, animalele pot găsi prăzi și parteneri și pot simți prădătoarele de la distanță.

programme.title: Rezervații naturale din oceane
programme.desc: Insulele Exuma Cays sunt o minune îndepărtată: sute de insulițe care se întind la sud de capitala Bahamasului, Nassau. În anii '50, dezvoltatorii visau să dezvolte această regiune superbă și predominant neexplorată. Înainte să înceapă construcțiile, însă, guvernul din Bahamas a finanțat o expediție care să cartografieze insulițele formate pe recife. Le-a plăcut ce au văzut, iar în 1959 au înființat Trustul Național Bahamas, creând primul Parc Oceanic din Bahamas.

programme.title: Ținutul creaturilor ciudate
programme.desc: Explorați viața animalelor cu sânge rece din Madagascar. Cameleoni, broaște, șopârle și șerpi, toate s-au adaptat pentru a supraviețui pe insulă. Vom vedea cum găsesc hrană, cum se reproduc și cum evită prădătoarele.

programme.title: Pui în sălbăticie
programme.desc: Testează-ți limitele cu puiul de jaguar Frida, care își perfecționează abilitățile de supraviețuire în rezervația Caiman Lodge. Învață cum să te furișezi cu mama Gatuna, urmărește-o pe sora Anouk cum se ascunde și pornește singur într-o drumeție.

programme.title: Pui în sălbăticie
programme.desc: Urmărește-o pe Lola cum face primii pași pe un câmp de luptă de pe coasta Argentinei. Înveselește-te văzând-o cum învață să comunice și să înoate, cum luptă să rămână alături de mama Maria și cum scapă rapid din ghearele morții.

programme.title: Pui în sălbăticie
programme.desc: Simte farmecul Pădurii Atlantice din Brazilia în timp ce Dora, un pui de muriqui din sud, face primii pași departe de mama Mimi. Ia lecții despre dinamica grupurilor de maimuțe-păianjen, perfecționează-ți tehnica de agățare a cozii și vezi cum își găsește locul acest pui printre semenii săi.

programme.title: Pui în sălbăticie
programme.desc: Pornește în aventură cu Thiago, un pui de coati foarte curajos. Urmărește acest exemplar asemănător ratonului și află cum își perfecționează abilitățile de adulmecare și de căutare a hranei, cum traversează drumurile suburbane din apropierea pădurii braziliene luxuriante în care locuiește și cum se ferește de tot soiul de pericole.

programme.title: Pui în sălbăticie
programme.desc: Vizitează ultima fortăreață a vidrei uriașe din frumoasa zonă umedă Pantanal, aflată în Brazilia. Urmărește-l pe Rio și frații săi cum testează apele, cum fac echipă pentru a se sustrage dintr-o ambuscadă pusă la cale de un jaguar și cum ajung să devină o familie unită care vânează împreună și o duce bine.

programme.title: Bandele de lemuri
programme.desc: Presiunea de a găsi hrană atinge noi cote și aduce multă agitație în rezervație. În plus, bandele de lemuri încep să se dezbine, determinând-o pe Crystal, liderul aprig al bandei Ruins, să se confrunte cu o situație de care nu a mai avut parte până în prezent.

programme.title: Fauna din adâncuri
programme.desc: Coasta Wild Coast din Africa de Sud se întinde pe o lungime de 273 km. Aici, apele Oceanului Indian și ale Atlanticului converg, trimițând spre țărm valuri puternice. Aici, Andrea Marshal, cercetătoare din Mozambic specializată în pisici de mare, speră să conducă prima ei expediție de cercetare a pisicilor de mare de pe teritoriul Africii de Sud.

programme.title: Fauna din adâncuri
programme.desc: Coasta sălbatică a Mozambicului se întinde pe o lungime de peste 2.500 km - o zonă plină de viețuitoare marine. Unele dintre cele mai mari animale marine care se hrănesc prin filtrare sunt atrase de aceste ape bogate în nutrimente. Dar chiar și aceste viețuitoare mari sunt lipsite de apărare față de pescuitul excesiv. Andrea Marshall și Nakia Cullain, doi dintre principalii cercetători marini din Mozambic, pornesc în căutarea unuia dintre cele mai eluzive animale și le protejează pe cele mai cunoscute dintre ele, înainte să fie prea târziu.

programme.title: Fauna din adâncuri
programme.desc: Coasta Mozambicului găzduiește giganți precum balenele cu cocoașă sau rechinii-balenă, însă și speciile foarte mici joacă un rol la fel de important în ecosistem. Faceți cunoștință cu oamenii de știință care se luptă din greu să protejeze toate animalele de coastă, indiferent de dimensiunea lor.

programme.title: Fauna din adâncuri
programme.desc: Oceanul se întinde pe 70% din suprafața planetei noastre și în el trăiesc în jur de un milion de specii cunoscute de plante și animale. Totuși, cele mai mici creaturi oceanice stau la baza celei mai ample resurse de hrană din lume - planctonul. Aceste organisme microscopice plutesc prin habitatele diverse ale oceanului, declanșând cicluri de hrănire pe unde trec. În absența lor nu ar mai exista viață în ocean.

programme.title: Cer sălbatic
programme.desc: Scrutați cerul Australiei care oferă unele dintre cele mai volatile condiții meteorologice din lume. Așteptați ploile musonice, urmăriți fulgerele care produc incendii și minunați-vă de adaptările ingenioase care ajută fauna sălbatică să facă față.

programme.title: Cer sălbatic
programme.desc: Descoperiți fenomenele puternice și colorate ce străbat cerul Americii de Nord. Priviți urșii polari căutând hrană sub Aurora Boreală, cartografiați deplasarea unui vortex polar și scăpați de tornade violente alături de o familie de câini de prerie.

programme.title: Cer sălbatic
programme.desc: Eterna căutare a apei definește viața animalelor sălbatice din Africa. Asistați la cea mai mare frenezie a hranei marine de pe Pământ, vedeți cum își iau cobrele energie solară și urmăriți gnu și elefanții în migrațiile lor epice.

programme.title: Latura sălbatică a Lunii
programme.desc: Vezi cum fazele lunii stabilesc ritmul unei lupte nesfârșite între prădător și pradă. Plutește alături de colugo, savurează un festin cu fructe de mare alături de macaci și vezi o haită de lei care încearcă să transforme în cină un pui de elefant.

programme.title: Abisul extraterestru
programme.desc: Faceți cunoștință cu multe ciudățenii din ocean și aflați cum miliarde de ani de schimbări, de la epoci de gheață la asteroizi, le-au schimbat aspectul și abilitățile. Vedeți viermi orbi care pescuiesc, rechini cu picioare, crabi care urcă în copaci și multe altele.

programme.title: Abisul extraterestru
programme.desc: Simțiți dragostea din parteneriatul ciudat dar plin de dragoste dintre unele dintre cele mai ciudate creaturi de pe Pământ. Coborâți în profunzime pentru a vedea animale ciudate, de la creveți cu clești la țipari-lup, care își ajută colegii ciudați din ocean, în vederea supraviețuirii reciproce.

programme.title: Abisul extraterestru
programme.desc: Pregătiți-vă latura științifico-fantastică și explocați ritualurile de împerechere ciudate ale celor mai bizare creaturi din ocean. Aflați cum luptele sângeroase pentru masculi, schimbarea sexului și puii de dimeniuni extraordinare pot asigura o generație viitoare pentru aceste animale.

programme.desc: Cu: Dana Chera.

programme.title: Telemedika
programme.desc: O emisiune care va avea ca invitați medici cunoscuți care ne vor învăța cum să ne ferim de anumite boli, unde vor fi expuse particularitățile acestor boli, dar și discuții despre tipuri de patologii. Emisiunea TeleMedika are un scop educativ pentru a încerca să învețe telespectatorul să prevină apariția diverselor afecțiuni. Formatul permite interacţiunea directă între medicii invitaţi şi telespectatori prin intermediul telefonului şi a reţelelor sociale.

programme.title: Medika Special
programme.desc: Cu: Andrada Popovici.

programme.title: Academia de sănătate
programme.desc: Academia de Sănătate este un show informativ bazat, în mare parte, pe interviuri cu renumiți profesori universitari din domeniul medical. Subiectele emisiunii sunt de actualitate şi sunt menite să ridice misterul asupra unor boli cu notorietate și să facă lumină în ceea ce privește actul medical de calitate. Domeniul medical este unul vast din toate punctele de vedere şi de aceea considerăm că introducerea în grila de programe a emisiunilor de acest tip este una benefică pentru telespectatori. În această emisiune telespectatorii au posibilitatea să fie informaţi direct de la cei ce sunt responsabili de actul medical. Formatl show-ului va încuraja dezbaterile, iar finalul va fi uşor de comunicat.

programme.title: Jurnal de viaţă
programme.desc: O emisiune despre excelența în profesia de medic, cu invitați profesioniști în domeniul medical, oameni care performează în acest domeniu. Formatul show-ului este acela de infodoc având linia narativă a unei biografii. Scopul emisiunii este acela de a-i apropia pe campionii domeniului de publicul telespectator, de a prezenta momentele de inflexiune din cariera acestora, performanţele profesionale, planurile de viitor, predincţiile acestora în ceea ce priveşte noile descoperiri şi tendinţe în domeniul lor de expertiză şi activitate.

programme.title: Underdog
programme.desc: Simon şi-a scris autobiografia. E convins că e o capodoperă şi că, în curând, toată lumea îi va cădea la picioare. Dar când vede că Cad n-a înţeles niciun cuvânt, Simon decide să folosească o invenţie, Mănuşa Sinistră, ca să-i facă pe oameni mai deştepţi şi să-i poată aprecia măreţia. Numai că atunci apare Cod, fratele geamăn al lui Cad. E la fel de prostuţ ca fratele său şi foloseşte Mănuşa Sinistră ca să provoace haos în tot oraşul. Apărătorii sunt chemaţi în ajutor, dar Underdog începe să se întrebe dacă e chiar atât de deştept pe cât credea...

programme.title: Underdog
programme.desc: Bad Dog consideră că problema oraşului Capitol City e că totul e prea „bun” şi perfect, aşa că vrea să schimbe asta. Foloseşte asupra populaţiei un dispozitiv care poate implanta un gând în mintea cuiva. Acum oraşul e în haos! Underdog încearcă să pună mâna pe dispozitiv, dar e mai greu decât credea, mai ales după ce Bad Dog i-a modificat softul lui Mechapup, care nu mai spune adevărul.

programme.title: Living with Dad 01

programme.title: Living with Dad 01

Dar nu se pot pune de acord în privința candidatelor, mai ales tata! Să fie oare casiera de la supermarket cea mai bună alegere pentru el?

programme.title: Living with Dad 01
programme.desc: Ondine și Panda se ceartă mai rău ca niciodată, ceea ce o pune pe Roxane într-o situație imposibilă. Drept urmare, viața în apartament devine un coșmar. programme.title: Living with Dad 01
programme.desc: Creșa lui Bebe Bella este închisă din cauza unor conducte sparte. Tata și Jérôme Lapraline intră în panică: trebuie să aibă grijă de micuța Bella și de gemene astăzi. În pripă, singura soluție a tatălui este să le încredințeze fiicelor sale grija celor trei bebelușe pentru o zi.

programme.title: Living with Dad 01
programme.desc: Panda a decis să părăsească casa părintească pentru a se muta la căminul studenţesc: acolo se va putea concentra sută la sută asupra studiilor și va putea spune adio dramelor neîntrerupte din apartament! Tata e complet distrus de vestea plecării fiicei sale mai mari, dar surorile ei sunt încântate: Panda va avea parte de liniște și pace în căminul studenţesc, iar fetele vor avea parte de același lucru acasă! Deja se pregătesc pentru “viața fără Panda”. programme.title: Living with Dad 01

programme.title: Living with Dad 01
programme.desc: Văzând că familia ei petrece mai mult timp în fața ecranelor decât împreună, Roxane decide să-și convingă surorile și tatăl să accepte provocarea de a nu le mai folosi! Dar provocarea se dovedește mult mai greu de respectat decât pare.

programme.title: Living with Dad 01
programme.desc: Panda nu are de ales decât să-i împrumute cheia lui Ondine, poreclită "Domnișoara Minte-Împrăștiată" de către familia ei, dar este hotărâtă să demonstreze că se pot baza pe ea! Doar că tot pierde cheia! Face tot posibilul ca tata și Panda să nu afle. Efix pleacă în căutarea cheii și o va ține la curent cu evoluția lucrurilor.

programme.title: Living with Dad 01
programme.desc: Tatei îi place să se simtă util. Când fiicele sale îi aruncă priviri recunoscătoare, se simte ca... SUPERTATA! Dar, astăzi, ajunge prea târziu pentru a o ajuta pe Roxane să-și asambleze raftul; când ajunge acasă, fetele îl anunță mândre că au reușit să se descurce SINGURE.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Jaguar is not only the coolest car brand from Britain, but the coolest car brand in the world. While the manufacturer was founded as the Swallow Sidecar Company by Sir William Lyons in 1922, the first Jaguar premiered in 1935. Shortly afterwards the Jaguar SS 100 was introduced, which fascinated with its power, dynamics and elegance and thus paved the ways for models like the XK 120, the E-Type or the XJ. Car History showcases all the models from the SS 100 to the latest F-Type and looks back at Jaguar's success in motorsports.

Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:\r\nmovement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparing\r\nand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we meet Cheryl Dunn, photographer. After moving to New York City in the mid-1980s, she spent much of her career photographing the city's streets and the people who made their mark on them. In the late 1990s, she began to focus on film, creating classic films about artists of her generation who influenced the realities of urban life through their own work.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "The Pushkin Museum: five hundred years of master drawings" at the Fondation Custodia in Paris. The works are displayed in such a way that visitors can observe the evolution of drawings over five centuries. There are drawings by the Italian artist Frederico Zuccari (or Zuccaro) but also the Dutch artist Peter Paul Rubens.

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.desc: In the heart of the Montparnasse district, the Bourdelle Museum remains one of the last testimonies of these groups of artists which flourished in Paris at the threshold of the 20th century. The Antoine Bourdelle Museum offers an opportunity to see the work being created it, as close as possible to the material, in the museum's workshop spirit. Plaster, earth, sandstone and bronzes, but also sketches, variations and variations, reveal the process of development and the working method of an artist as fertile as inventive.

programme.title: Origami
programme.desc: Origami is about the art of paper folding, a Japanese and Chinese millenary tradition. In modern usage, the word “origami” is used as an inclusive term for all paper folding, regardless of their cultural origin. Different folding and sculpting techniques, new models, bright colors – you’ll see all of this in our program! We will teach you how to transform a flat square sheet of paper into a finished sculpture – from simple to complex!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: A key artist of the Italian Renaissance, Raffaello Santi (1483-1520) developed a classical art form, based on drawing, which made him the model for many painters in the following centuries. His favourite theme was the Madonna: you can admire, for example, “The Sistine Madonna” in Dresden and the “The Virgin and Child with St John the Baptist” in the Louvre. Notice the gentle harmony and the delicate sensuality in “The Three Graces” or the powerful human presence in “The Portrait of Baldassare Castiglione”.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: When I grow up I'll be a photographer
programme.desc: In this episode, Christina, a student, is going to play the game and take pictures for a jewelry brand. We will attend a first year image analysis class. The students who did a photoshoot with a duck in the previous episode will edit the photos, and one student will organize a photoshoot on the street.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: Two photographers compete on a given theme. Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, will then have to decide between them and choose the best of the two. Today, the Phocaean city is at the heart of the competition: the two competitors must capture the most aesthetic and unusual aspects of it.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we will talk about the artist Antoine Bourdelle. Son of a carpenter who moved to the capital, Antoine Bourdelle became the most important official sculptor at the beginning of the 20th century. This pupil of Rodin took on numerous commissions in France and abroad. But he also kept some of his sculptures still present today in his workshop in the Montparnasse district, a magical place, which has remained frozen in the past.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: In the second half of the 19th century, Edouard Manet (1832-1883) showed great originality in his painting of historic scenes and portraiture of well-known figures, such as the novelist Zola and the poet Mallarmé. Even if we cannot call him the first Impressionist, his leading role in the history of modern art must be emphasised. The scandals in 1863 caused by “The Luncheon on the Grass” or “Olympia” both exposed at the Orsay Museum effectively mark the beginning of modern painting.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: John Singer Sargent - Portraitist of Paradox
programme.desc:
From September 22, 2025 to January 11, 2026, following its presentation at The Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York, the Musée d’Orsay will devote a major exhibition to John Singer Sargent (1856–1925), marking the centenary of the painter’s death.
A century after his passing, John Singer Sargent—celebrated for his portraits of French, English, and American high society during the Belle Époque—remains an enigma. Beneath a façade of carefully maintained respectability, his work nonetheless shocked his contemporaries with its sensuality and candor. Idolized by a wealthy elite eager to pay a fortune to sit for him, another side of his oeuvre reveals his fascination with Bedouins, Spanish dancers, and Venetian gondoliers.
This film offers a portrait full of contradictions: an American born in Florence, we follow him from his nomadic childhood across Europe, through the salons of Paris and London, and finally to the United States, his homeland.
Although immensely successful during his life.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet Martin Schoeller, German photographer. His style is characterized by a similar treatment of all subjects photographed, whether they are famous or anonymous. His portraits of Brad Pitt, Steve Carrel, Bradley Cooper and many others, are published in renowned magazines.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet the artist Ben. Active on the contemporary art scene for over 50 years, he is a self-taught, multi-faceted character. His success is undeniable. If his status as an artist is affirmed through his famous writings painted in white cursive letters on a black background, his temperament as a "jack of all trades" has made him one of the most avant-garde artistic personalities in the art world since the 1960s. Attached more than anything else to his region, the artist has been working and living for over 40 years in the heights of Nice, in Saint-Pancrace, in a house where each room can become a studio, and where the progressive lack of space has led him to create an extension, the doors of which he is now opening to us.

programme.title: Warning ! Fresh paint
programme.desc: Move along, there's nothing to see! In April 2018, the Museum "La Piscine de Roubaix" prepared to expand its exhibition space. In a period of six months, several thousand works had to be unhooked, dusted, restored, moved, and reinstalled. These are unique works for which any handling required extreme precautions. Bruno Gaudichon, curator and founder of the museum, had to employ and bring together several workers in ordert to complete a successful reopening.

programme.title: Private Tour

This is the first retrospective devoted to this Italian artist. You will discover his ceramic works from the beginning of his career, but also the furniture designs anchored in his poetic and subtle universe.

programme.title: We are Artists not Vandals
programme.desc: Born in Le Havre in 1968, CyKlop practices a playful, popular and often interactive art. He is known for his installations of urban furniture that color the city and whose offbeat poetry brings a touch of fantasy to the street. He also uses numerous supports and revisits the myth of Ulysses and the Cyclops through everyday objects that became toys, sculptures or art objects.

It is also in the museum of ceramics that some of the most beautiful works of the "potter" Picasso are exhibited. The sculpture of “Man with a Sheep”, placed on the Market Square, testifies to the artist's attachment to the city and its inhabitants. In 1959, the castle chapel was inaugurated with his masterpiece "War and Peace" just across the museum Magnelli.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Although Degas’ art is difficult to classify, it is often associated with the impressionist movement, which emerged in France at the end of the 19th century. Nevertheless, he developed a very personal style with a preference for indoors subjects rather than the open-air scenes favoured by the impressionist painters. The 10 masterpieces presented here are a good illustration of Degas’ preferred themes: the show, the bath, family portraits and the working classes.\r\nDiscover " The Ballet classe " exposed at the Orsay Museum or the " Blue Dancers " at the Fine arts Museum Pouchkine.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Othoniel Cosmos - An Artist in Avignon
programme.desc: Cosmos, an Artist in Avignon is a poetic documentary that follows Jean-Michel Othoniel during the creation of his monumental exhibition in Avignon (2025–2026). Through his perspective, the film explores the intimate genesis of his works, from conception to realization, from spirit to matter.\r\nStructured around the four elements, this sensory journey takes us from Jean-Michel’s studio in Montreuil to the workshops of the many artisans collaborating on the project, as well as to the iconic sites of Avignon. The city becomes a stage where the artworks integrate and dialogue with the spaces, between contemporary installation and historical heritage.\r\nThe journey culminates in a choreographic performance by Carolyn Carlson, created for Othoniel’s works and performed by Hugo Marchand and Caroline Osmont, presented for the first time in the courtyard of the Palais des Papes.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: It is in the center of Buenos Aires that Eduardo Stupia decided to install his studio entirely dedicated to creation. In a 20th century house, wedged between two modern buildings, he occupies a large space in which he can indulge in his favorite art, drawing. His works, which he describes himself as abstract landscapes, are drawn with pencil, charcoal or Indian ink. In his heterogeneous compositions, where the graphic language and the precision of the gesture hold a central place, Eduardo Stupia explores the semantics of the drawing and opens the fields of the imagination.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Born in 1866 in Moscow, Wassily Kandinsky is considered as one of the most important 20th century artists. He was notably the founder of abstract art. Having left Russia for Germany where he started teaching at the Bauhaus in 1922, he then settled in France in 1933 and left behind him a particularly abundant work. You will rediscover here his most emblematic creations, essentially drawn from the collection of the Centre Pompidou in Paris.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.desc: The city of Boulogne Billancourt experienced rapid development in the interwar period. Industrialists, filmmakers, architects, painters and sculptors test their creativity there. It is this impetus that the Museum of the 1930s would have liked to transcribe, created a collection of works of art from this period, first constituted by purchases in galleries, flea markets or auction houses, then mainly by donations. More than 1,500 sculptures, 800 paintings, 300 pieces of furniture… A heterogeneous whole, testimony of an era and a place in which the artistic excitement unfolds, and opens the way to a number of creative adventures of the 20th century.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Between 1883 and 1926 Claude Monet lived in a house at Giverny where he created a flower garden and a water garden, which provided the inspiration for his series of paintings known as the “Water Lilies”. The “Water-Lily Pond” portrays this garden, with its water lilies and the Japanese bridge in the background. In the series of eight large canvases on the theme, housed in the Musée de l’Orangerie in Paris, Monet introduces variations in light according to the hour of the day.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Artist portrait - Quentin Carnaille
programme.desc: Born 31 years ago in Roubaix, Quentin Carnaille quickly became a force on the art scene north of France. Former architecture student, Carnaille has always been fascinated by how things work. His early works were influenced by clockwork mechanisms, he has diverted from their main use to create jewelry and accessories. It then focuses on the realization of sculptures and greater works with the same aesthetic and inspiration. The contemporary and futuristic ideas influence his work from the beginning, based on its initial orientation on the past and the origins of humanity.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet Lee Backer, photographer. He started his career in 1969. His main interests are in natural and man-made landscapes. His passion for natural landscapes began in his youth in rural Northwestern New Jersey.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "Fernand Khnopff - The master of the enigma" at the Petit Palais in Paris. The work that introduces the visit of the exhibition dedicated to this amazing artist is called "silence". The artist represented landscapes of his childhood in the Ardennes in France. But he also painted portraits, paintings representing his mother as his painting entitled "Listening to Schumann".

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we meet the artist Alain Godon. From the shores of France to the English countryside, from parachutist to nightclub manager, Alain Godon has had a thousand and one lives. But he has always remained a painter. He is a figurative painter with a naive and cheerful pencil stroke, who, far from fashions, trends and museum fads, is acclaimed by many collectors for whom he works from his workshop in Waltham in Kent.

programme.title: Origami

We will teach you how to transform a flat square sheet of paper into a finished sculpture – from simple to complex!

Indeed, Raw Art is constantly renewing itself, it is not limited by time or by the style and remains foremost vector emotional message.

The “Fanciful Figure” exposed at the Louvre-Lens demonstrates an original and very modern style. One of his masterpieces is without doubt the painting “The Bolt”, in the collection of the Louvre in Paris.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

Has their approach evolved along with their art?\r\nTo tell these stories, we've come up with a fabulous playground: Laon's International Urban Arts festival.

In the late 1990s, she began to focus on film, creating classic films about artists of her generation who influenced the realities of urban life through their own work.

There are drawings by the Italian artist Frederico Zuccari (or Zuccaro) but also the Dutch artist Peter Paul Rubens.

The Antoine Bourdelle Museum offers an opportunity to see the work being created it, as close as possible to the material, in the museum's workshop spirit. Plaster, earth, sandstone and bronzes, but also sketches, variations and variations, reveal the process of development and the working method of an artist as fertile as inventive.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: A key artist of the Italian Renaissance, Raffaello Santi (1483-1520) developed a classical art form, based on drawing, which made him the model for many painters in the following centuries. His favourite theme was the Madonna: you can admire, for example, “The Sistine Madonna” in Dresden and the “The Virgin and Child with St John the Baptist” in the Louvre. Notice the gentle harmony and the delicate sensuality in “The Three Graces” or the powerful human presence in “The Portrait of Baldassare Castiglione”.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.desc: In this episode, Christina, a student, is going to play the game and take pictures for a jewelry brand. We will attend a first year image analysis class. The students who did a photoshoot with a duck in the previous episode will edit the photos, and one student will organize a photoshoot on the street.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: Two photographers compete on a given theme. Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, will then have to decide between them and choose the best of the two. Today, the Phocaean city is at the heart of the competition: the two competitors must capture the most aesthetic and unusual aspects of it.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we will talk about the artist Antoine Bourdelle. Son of a carpenter who moved to the capital, Antoine Bourdelle became the most important official sculptor at the beginning of the 20th century. This pupil of Rodin took on numerous commissions in France and abroad. But he also kept some of his sculptures still present today in his workshop in the Montparnasse district, a magical place, which has remained frozen in the past.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: In the second half of the 19th century, Edouard Manet (1832-1883) showed great originality in his painting of historic scenes and portraiture of well-known figures, such as the novelist Zola and the poet Mallarmé. Even if we cannot call him the first Impressionist, his leading role in the history of modern art must be emphasised. The scandals in 1863 caused by “The Luncheon on the Grass” or “Olympia” both exposed at the Orsay Museum effectively mark the beginning of modern painting.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: John Singer Sargent - Portraitist of Paradox
programme.desc:
From September 22, 2025 to January 11, 2026, following its presentation at The Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York, the Musée d’Orsay will devote a major exhibition to John Singer Sargent (1856–1925), marking the centenary of the painter’s death.
A century after his passing, John Singer Sargent—celebrated for his portraits of French, English, and American high society during the Belle Époque—remains an enigma. Beneath a façade of carefully maintained respectability, his work nonetheless shocked his contemporaries with its sensuality and candor. Idolized by a wealthy elite eager to pay a fortune to sit for him, another side of his oeuvre reveals his fascination with Bedouins, Spanish dancers, and Venetian gondoliers.
This film offers a portrait full of contradictions: an American born in Florence, we follow him from his nomadic childhood across Europe, through the salons of Paris and London, and finally to the United States, his homeland.
Although immensely successful during his life.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet Martin Schoeller, German photographer. His style is characterized by a similar treatment of all subjects photographed, whether they are famous or anonymous. His portraits of Brad Pitt, Steve Carrel, Bradley Cooper and many others, are published in renowned magazines.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet the artist Ben. Active on the contemporary art scene for over 50 years, he is a self-taught, multi-faceted character. His success is undeniable. If his status as an artist is affirmed through his famous writings painted in white cursive letters on a black background, his temperament as a "jack of all trades" has made him one of the most avant-garde artistic personalities in the art world since the 1960s. Attached more than anything else to his region, the artist has been working and living for over 40 years in the heights of Nice, in Saint-Pancrace, in a house where each room can become a studio, and where the progressive lack of space has led him to create an extension, the doors of which he is now opening to us.

programme.title: Warning ! Fresh paint
programme.desc: Move along, there's nothing to see! In April 2018, the Museum "La Piscine de Roubaix" prepared to expand its exhibition space. In a period of six months, several thousand works had to be unhooked, dusted, restored, moved, and reinstalled. These are unique works for which any handling required extreme precautions. Bruno Gaudichon, curator and founder of the museum, had to employ and bring together several workers in ordert to complete a successful reopening.

programme.desc: In this episode we visit the city of Vallauris where Pablo Picasso became fascinated by the town and the ceramics after visiting an exhibition and it’s where he lived for a decade. The city remains forever marked by the work of this protean artist. Picasso is known in Vallauris for the chapel of the castle and its impressive cycle of paintings entitled "War and Peace". It is also in the museum of ceramics that some of the most beautiful works of the "potter" Picasso are exhibited. The sculpture of “Man with a Sheep”, placed on the Market Square, testifies to the artist's attachment to the city and its inhabitants. In 1959, the castle chapel was inaugurated with his masterpiece "War and Peace" just across the museum Magnelli.

This exhibition retraces the great stages in Monet’s prolific career while dwelling on paintings of this master that cannot be ignored: the “Saint Lazare Station”, the “Poppies near Argenteuil”, the “Haystacks” and the “Rouen Cathedral” exposed all around the world in different museum such as the Museum of Fine Arts in Boston without forgetting his “Water-lilies” exposed at the Orangerie museum in Paris. \r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame

Nevertheless, he developed a very personal style with a preference for indoors subjects rather than the open-air scenes favoured by the impressionist painters. The 10 masterpieces presented here are a good illustration of Degas’ preferred themes: the show, the bath, family portraits and the working classes.\r\nDiscover " The Ballet classe " exposed at the Orsay Museum or the " Blue Dancers " at the Fine arts Museum Pouchkine.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Othoniel Cosmos - An Artist in Avignon
programme.desc: Cosmos, an Artist in Avignon is a poetic documentary that follows Jean-Michel Othoniel during the creation of his monumental exhibition in Avignon (2025–2026). Through his perspective, the film explores the intimate genesis of his works, from conception to realization, from spirit to matter.\r\nStructured around the four elements, this sensory journey takes us from Jean-Michel’s studio in Montreuil to the workshops of the many artisans collaborating on the project, as well as to the iconic sites of Avignon. The city becomes a stage where the artworks integrate and dialogue with the spaces, between contemporary installation and historical heritage.\r\nThe journey culminates in a choreographic performance by Carolyn Carlson, created for Othoniel’s works and performed by Hugo Marchand and Caroline Osmont, presented for the first time in the courtyard of the Palais des Papes.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: It is in the center of Buenos Aires that Eduardo Stupia decided to install his studio entirely dedicated to creation. In a 20th century house, wedged between two modern buildings, he occupies a large space in which he can indulge in his favorite art, drawing. His works, which he describes himself as abstract landscapes, are drawn with pencil, charcoal or Indian ink. In his heterogeneous compositions, where the graphic language and the precision of the gesture hold a central place, Eduardo Stupia explores the semantics of the drawing and opens the fields of the imagination.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Born in 1866 in Moscow, Wassily Kandinsky is considered as one of the most important 20th century artists. He was notably the founder of abstract art. Having left Russia for Germany where he started teaching at the Bauhaus in 1922, he then settled in France in 1933 and left behind him a particularly abundant work. You will rediscover here his most emblematic creations, essentially drawn from the collection of the Centre Pompidou in Paris.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.desc: The city of Boulogne Billancourt experienced rapid development in the interwar period. Industrialists, filmmakers, architects, painters and sculptors test their creativity there. It is this impetus that the Museum of the 1930s would have liked to transcribe, created a collection of works of art from this period, first constituted by purchases in galleries, flea markets or auction houses, then mainly by donations. More than 1,500 sculptures, 800 paintings, 300 pieces of furniture… A heterogeneous whole, testimony of an era and a place in which the artistic excitement unfolds, and opens the way to a number of creative adventures of the 20th century.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: A key artist of the Italian Renaissance, Raffaello Santi (1483-1520) developed a classical art form, based on drawing, which made him the model for many painters in the following centuries. His favourite theme was the Madonna: you can admire, for example, “The Sistine Madonna” in Dresden and the “The Virgin and Child with St John the Baptist” in the Louvre. Notice the gentle harmony and the delicate sensuality in “The Three Graces” or the powerful human presence in “The Portrait of Baldassare Castiglione”.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

Son of a carpenter who moved to the capital, Antoine Bourdelle became the most important official sculptor at the beginning of the 20th century. This pupil of Rodin took on numerous commissions in France and abroad. But he also kept some of his sculptures still present today in his workshop in the Montparnasse district, a magical place, which has remained frozen in the past.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: In the second half of the 19th century, Edouard Manet (1832-1883) showed great originality in his painting of historic scenes and portraiture of well-known figures, such as the novelist Zola and the poet Mallarmé. Even if we cannot call him the first Impressionist, his leading role in the history of modern art must be emphasised. The scandals in 1863 caused by “The Luncheon on the Grass” or “Olympia” both exposed at the Orsay Museum effectively mark the beginning of modern painting.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: John Singer Sargent - Portraitist of Paradox
programme.desc:
From September 22, 2025 to January 11, 2026, following its presentation at The Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York, the Musée d’Orsay will devote a major exhibition to John Singer Sargent (1856–1925), marking the centenary of the painter’s death.
A century after his passing, John Singer Sargent—celebrated for his portraits of French, English, and American high society during the Belle Époque—remains an enigma. Beneath a façade of carefully maintained respectability, his work nonetheless shocked his contemporaries with its sensuality and candor. Idolized by a wealthy elite eager to pay a fortune to sit for him, another side of his oeuvre reveals his fascination with Bedouins, Spanish dancers, and Venetian gondoliers.
This film offers a portrait full of contradictions: an American born in Florence, we follow him from his nomadic childhood across Europe, through the salons of Paris and London, and finally to the United States, his homeland.
Although immensely successful during his life.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet the artist Ben. Active on the contemporary art scene for over 50 years, he is a self-taught, multi-faceted character. His success is undeniable. If his status as an artist is affirmed through his famous writings painted in white cursive letters on a black background, his temperament as a "jack of all trades" has made him one of the most avant-garde artistic personalities in the art world since the 1960s. Attached more than anything else to his region, the artist has been working and living for over 40 years in the heights of Nice, in Saint-Pancrace, in a house where each room can become a studio, and where the progressive lack of space has led him to create an extension, the doors of which he is now opening to us.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Warning ! Fresh paint
programme.desc: Move along, there's nothing to see! In April 2018, the Museum "La Piscine de Roubaix" prepared to expand its exhibition space. In a period of six months, several thousand works had to be unhooked, dusted, restored, moved, and reinstalled. These are unique works for which any handling required extreme precautions. Bruno Gaudichon, curator and founder of the museum, had to employ and bring together several workers in ordert to complete a successful reopening.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to the discovery of the retrospective "Tutto Ponti" which retraces 60 years of the career of the architect-designer Gio Ponti at the decorative arts museum. This is the first retrospective devoted to this Italian artist. You will discover his ceramic works from the beginning of his career, but also the furniture designs anchored in his poetic and subtle universe.

programme.title: We are Artists not Vandals
programme.desc: Born in Le Havre in 1968, CyKlop practices a playful, popular and often interactive art. He is known for his installations of urban furniture that color the city and whose offbeat poetry brings a touch of fantasy to the street. He also uses numerous supports and revisits the myth of Ulysses and the Cyclops through everyday objects that became toys, sculptures or art objects.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet Giles Clarke, photojournalist. He has covered many areas of conflict and humanitarian crisis. He will tell us about the dangers of his work, the difficulties it presents, his motivations, and his views on the world around us and its crises.

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:\r\nmovement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparing\r\nand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Secret treasures
programme.desc: Secret treasures makes you discover the Thiers Library in Paris. It is a place that houses many treasures that we do not suspect the existence. Today, we will visit this exceptional place which is the property of the Institute of France in search of the treasures it contains. Experts, historians, librarians, will guide us through the corridors and floors of this magical place.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode we will meet the artist Christian Lapie. He is an artist who created works and installations that surprised and seduced the public. But in the mid-1990s, he abandoned his projects in search of a universal message. Since then, he has devoted himself to sculpture and has installed his statues all over the world.

programme.title: The Edge of Art
programme.desc: Art collector Andrew Wilson teams up with curator and experiential designer Courtney Hammond to explore the uncharted waters of NFTs in the art world. As they gain a greater appreciation of the metaverse, they challenge renowned Atlanta-based artists to create a piece in the NFT domain- a medium which most have never dared to delve into before.

programme.title: Museum Tour
programme.desc: In this episode we visit the city of Vallauris where Pablo Picasso became fascinated by the town and the ceramics after visiting an exhibition and it’s where he lived for a decade. The city remains forever marked by the work of this protean artist. Picasso is known in Vallauris for the chapel of the castle and its impressive cycle of paintings entitled "War and Peace". It is also in the museum of ceramics that some of the most beautiful works of the "potter" Picasso are exhibited. The sculpture of “Man with a Sheep”, placed on the Market Square, testifies to the artist's attachment to the city and its inhabitants. In 1959, the castle chapel was inaugurated with his masterpiece "War and Peace" just across the museum Magnelli.

programme.title: Origami
programme.desc: Origami is about the art of paper folding, a Japanese and Chinese millenary tradition. In modern usage, the word “origami” is used as an inclusive term for all paper folding, regardless of their cultural origin. Different folding and sculpting techniques, new models, bright colors – you’ll see all of this in our program! We will teach you how to transform a flat square sheet of paper into a finished sculpture – from simple to complex!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Claude Monet is probably the best-known painter of the impressionist movement. Indeed, the term “impressionism” was derived from his painting “Impression Rising Sun” (1872). This exhibition retraces the great stages in Monet’s prolific career while dwelling on paintings of this master that cannot be ignored: the “Saint Lazare Station”, the “Poppies near Argenteuil”, the “Haystacks” and the “Rouen Cathedral” exposed all around the world in different museum such as the Museum of Fine Arts in Boston without forgetting his “Water-lilies” exposed at the Orangerie museum in Paris. \r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we'll be talking with Jennifer Khordi, photographer. She is a former computer professional from the Bronx. She started with street photography in the late 1980's and then moved into travel and portrait photography. She has spent the last few years photographing the moon, the Milky Way and New York City.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to the discovery of the exhibition "Giacometti, between tradition and avant-garde" at the Musée Maillol. This exhibition shows how Giacometti evolved from style to style. It tells his story from the first busts he sculpted at the age of 13, to the realization of large-scale sculptures towards the end of his life.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Although Degas’ art is difficult to classify, it is often associated with the impressionist movement, which emerged in France at the end of the 19th century. Nevertheless, he developed a very personal style with a preference for indoors subjects rather than the open-air scenes favoured by the impressionist painters. The 10 masterpieces presented here are a good illustration of Degas’ preferred themes: the show, the bath, family portraits and the working classes.\r\nDiscover " The Ballet classe " exposed at the Orsay Museum or the " Blue Dancers " at the Fine arts Museum Pouchkine.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.desc: Possibly the most renowned painter in the world, Vincent van Gogh was born in Holland in 1853 but spent most of his life in France. Suffering from mental instability, Van Gogh produced more that 2,000 paintings before committing suicide aged 37. You will discover during this visit some of his most famous masterpieces, in particularly two “Self-portraits” at the Orsay Museum, “Sunflowers” exposed at the National Gallery in London, “Starry Night” and the “Church at Auvers-sur-Oise”.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

The pair quickly realize that the success of their launch will be highly contingent on the involvement of the wider community.

programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to the discovery of the exhibition "Dancing Gross" at LaM in Villeneuve d'Ascq, the museum of modern, contemporary and raw art. It can be a simple photograph immortalizing a movement, a dance, or even reproductions of merry-go-rounds which will remind you the period of childhood.

programme.title: Othoniel Cosmos - An Artist in Avignon
programme.desc: Cosmos, an Artist in Avignon is a poetic documentary that follows Jean-Michel Othoniel during the creation of his monumental exhibition in Avignon (2025–2026). Through his perspective, the film explores the intimate genesis of his works, from conception to realization, from spirit to matter.\r\nStructured around the four elements, this sensory journey takes us from Jean-Michel’s studio in Montreuil to the workshops of the many artisans collaborating on the project, as well as to the iconic sites of Avignon. The city becomes a stage where the artworks integrate and dialogue with the spaces, between contemporary installation and historical heritage.\r\nThe journey culminates in a choreographic performance by Carolyn Carlson, created for Othoniel’s works and performed by Hugo Marchand and Caroline Osmont, presented for the first time in the courtyard of the Palais des Papes.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: It is in the center of Buenos Aires that Eduardo Stupia decided to install his studio entirely dedicated to creation. In a 20th century house, wedged between two modern buildings, he occupies a large space in which he can indulge in his favorite art, drawing. His works, which he describes himself as abstract landscapes, are drawn with pencil, charcoal or Indian ink. In his heterogeneous compositions, where the graphic language and the precision of the gesture hold a central place, Eduardo Stupia explores the semantics of the drawing and opens the fields of the imagination.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Born in 1866 in Moscow, Wassily Kandinsky is considered as one of the most important 20th century artists. He was notably the founder of abstract art. Having left Russia for Germany where he started teaching at the Bauhaus in 1922, he then settled in France in 1933 and left behind him a particularly abundant work. You will rediscover here his most emblematic creations, essentially drawn from the collection of the Centre Pompidou in Paris.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.desc: The city of Boulogne Billancourt experienced rapid development in the interwar period. Industrialists, filmmakers, architects, painters and sculptors test their creativity there. It is this impetus that the Museum of the 1930s would have liked to transcribe, created a collection of works of art from this period, first constituted by purchases in galleries, flea markets or auction houses, then mainly by donations. More than 1,500 sculptures, 800 paintings, 300 pieces of furniture… A heterogeneous whole, testimony of an era and a place in which the artistic excitement unfolds, and opens the way to a number of creative adventures of the 20th century.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: Today, we go to Marseille where two new candidates will compete. Juan Bosco Gomez Herrera and Lilian Heymans will have one hour to take the best possible photograph on the imposed theme of the sea.

With this exhibition, we try to question and understand what makes the success and originality of art brut. Among the works on display you will be able to discover works by the iconic Japanese artist Sawada who participated in the Venice Biennale in 2013.

The Venezuelan-born artist has been living there for nearly 5 years and has been making his rather unusual creations. His sculptures are composed of simple geometric figures, lines, triangles, squares or circles, which float in space suspended from almost invisible threads.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: With his considerable production of more than 6,000 works, Auguste Renoir took part in the emergence of the impressionist movement even if he were to distance himself from it later to assert a more personal style. This visit begins with his most famous masterpiece, the “Ball at the Moulin de la Galette”. You will also rediscover the “Dance in the City” and the “Piano Lesson” exposed at the Joslyn art museum as well as “Claude Renoir in Clown Costume”, a portrait of his son who was later to become one of France’s greatest film directors exposed at the Orangerie Museum in France \r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Taxidermy at work
programme.desc: Practice used since the Renaissance to fill the curiosity cabinets, taxidermy became obsolete in the 20th century. It owes its rehabilitation contemporary artists in the 90s crossed Portraits of three artists who use this practice in their works.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we'll talk with Drew Carolan, photographer. He has been making photographic work since 1973. His attraction to art began when he discovered graffiti in the early 1970s. He has worked as a photographer for MTV Networks, photographed more than a dozen independent feature films and done numerous record and DVD covers. As a director and producer, he has created numerous public service announcements as well as music videos, commercials and documentaries.

programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet the artist Erik Desmazières. He is one of the most famous printmakers in France, and is exhibited around the world. He has brought to this discipline, a little outdated, a form of modernity, thanks to his fantastic landscapes soaked in science-fiction, immediately noticed by the collectors. Member of the French Academy of Fine Arts since 2008, Erik Desmazières has turned in recent years to realistic landscapes.

programme.title: The Edge of Art
programme.desc: Artists Lisette Correa, Alicia Renee Ball and Bojana Ginn discuss the benefits of intertwining technology with their specific artistic focuses in patterning, spirituality, and mental health. Collectors and curators likewise delve into the process of developing a new eye for digital art, smart contracts, the crazy euphoria of the NFT marketplace, as well as how this new medium is going to positively impact the world.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The spectacular sculptures and paintings of Michelangelo seem so familiar to us, but what do we really know about this renaissance genius? Who was this ambitious and passionate man? A virtuoso craftsman, Michelangelo’s artistry is evident in everything he touched. Beautiful and diverse works such as the towering statue of David, the deeply moving Pietà in the Papal Basilica of St. Peter and his tour-de-force, the Sistine Chapel ceiling still leave us breathless today.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Rembrandt is widely considered to be the greatest Dutch painter of the 17th century. A master in the use of light, particularly the chiaroscuro technique, as well as an exceptionally talented draftsman, Rembrandt’s work was considerably influenced by the dramatic events of his life (the death of his wife, financial bankruptcy, etc.). You will discover in this exhibition some of his most famous paintings exposed at the Louvre, such as “Bathsheba at her Bath”, also exposed at Mauritshuis with “The Anatomy Lecture” or his famous self-portraits. \r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Housing a huge collection of European paintings from the Renaissance at the end of the 18th century, the Alte Pinakothek in Munich brims over with masterpieces. In particular it boasts several paintings by the great Flemish artist, Rubens, such as “The Battle of the Amazons”. Notice as well Durer’s “Paumgartner Altarpiece”, the impressive “Battle of Alexander at Issus” by the painter Altdofer, and also the “Land of Cockaigne” by Pieter Bruegel the Elder. Enjoy your visit!
